maintenance: Updated stale OCR pre-connection guidance to match the live secure OCR workflow.
Bumped app version to 2026.09.15-FINAL.1 so existing clients can detect the maintenance update.
Fresh installations now start with zero vending machines instead of injecting development sample machines A-F.
Existing localStorage data and IndexedDB recovery data remain authoritative and are not deleted by the empty-start maintenance.
Hardened OCR provider availability with bounded retry and fallback across Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.1 Flash-Lite.
Added distinct user-facing OCR failure categories for provider busy, timeout, connection, structured parse, authentication, and rejection failures.
Replaced the too-short sequential 8-second OCR model attempts with hedged provider requests: the primary model keeps running while fallback models start only if the prior request is slow or fails.
Raised the OCR provider attempt window to 30 seconds, the provider budget to 55 seconds, and the client relay timeout to 75 seconds.
Added realistic large-image production smoke coverage so tiny 1x1 test images can no longer falsely certify OCR latency.
Added a compact OCR review layer that shows all important values at a glance, highlights only deterministic uncertainty or inconsistencies, and opens the existing detailed editor only when requested.
Renamed OCR confidence presentation so report-type confidence is not mistaken for per-field OCR accuracy.
Added explicit registered-machine matching via maker/vendor identity, with user-confirmed machine linking for unique candidates.
Reduced input-confirmation OCR scope to analysis-relevant product/quantity fields instead of counter/payment reconciliation.
Added client-side OCR image optimization and visible processing progress to reduce upload and inference latency without storing images.
Fixed compact OCR review typography by replacing the generic .name/.code/.qty item classes with isolated OCR-specific classes, preventing collision with the global VENDRIVE brand .name style.
Reduced compact OCR item-row visual density while keeping product names readable and quantities emphasized.
Separated OCR uncertainty, consistency checks, and machine-link confirmation into distinct compact-review badges so a machine-link prompt is no longer presented as a generic OCR issue.
Added pinpoint inline editing for uncertain or missing metadata and item fields; only the flagged field opens for correction, while the existing full editor remains available at the bottom.
After a pinpoint correction, the matching uncertainty warning is cleared in-memory and the compact review is immediately re-evaluated without writing Analytics data.
OCR runs now use a generation token so failed, closed, replaced, or stale requests cannot leave or restore an older review beneath a newer error/result.
A current OCR failure explicitly clears the prior OCR review and in-memory OCR candidate before presenting the failure state.

Recovery case-conversion warnings are derived from structured recovery rows: false global warnings are removed when caseCount is zero, while genuinely unsafe case rows become pinpoint Japanese quantity checks with inline editing.

OCR draft creation now has an explicit success card and a separate user-confirmed finalization step. Confirmed sales reports become analysis inputs; confirmed input/recovery reports become inventory-calculation inputs.
Moved 帳票撮影 directly below the Today progress hero so it is available before scrolling through the visit list.
Visit completion now warns when that vending machine still has unfinished tasks; this applies to both swipe completion and normal visit completion.
End-of-day confirmation now warns about unfinished orders and task assignments only for vending machines in today's active route target set.

plannedPhases.title: Vehicle Inventory Initial Stocktake / Baseline UI
plannedPhases.purpose: Create a one-time real stocktake flow for current vehicle inventory using existing Analytics baseline semantics, with machine-list-style product search.

plannedPhases.title: Multi-axis Product Intelligence / First-seen Classification
plannedPhases.purpose: Replace single-category thinking with a structured product family plus multiple attributes; AI proposes classification and the user confirms once per new product.

plannedPhases.title: Classification-aware Demand Transfer / Replacement Analysis
plannedPhases.purpose: Use product similarity and multi-level aggregate demand to distinguish true demand decline from sales moving to a close substitute, and improve replacement suggestions.

plannedPhases.title: Explicit Active Visit / Nearby Candidate Workflow
plannedPhases.purpose: Use GPS only to surface nearby candidates; let the user explicitly start exactly one active machine, keep it pinned near the top, and cross-check OCR identity against it.

vehicleInventoryDirection: Do not reconstruct historical vehicle movements just to bootstrap current inventory.
Perform one real physical stocktake and register that timestamp as the starting baseline.
Provide live product search similar to the vending-machine list; search product name, product code, and maker.
Support case count plus loose units and convert only when case size is known; never invent case size.
Do not silently treat an unentered product as zero; the stocktake flow must make zero-vs-not-counted explicit.
After baseline, confirmed movements drive current stock; later real stocktakes use reconciliation/correction instead of rewriting history.
productIntelligenceDirection: The business purpose is revenue analysis and replacement decisions, not cosmetic categorization.
A single category such as coffee or carbonated drink is insufficient.
Use product family plus multiple structured attributes/tags so close substitutes can be identified at several similarity levels.
Example coffee attributes: black/milked, sugar level, milk presence, volume band, container, hot/cold compatibility, price band, brand/maker.
Example carbonated attributes: unsweetened sparkling water, cola, fruit soda, energy-style carbonation, lactic carbonation, plus flavor/sugar/volume/container/price/brand as applicable.
Not every attribute applies to every family; the model must remain extensible and allow unknown values without inventing facts.
When a new product first appears, AI may propose classification from product evidence; the user confirms once or fixes only wrong fields. Confirmed classification is then reused.
Analysis should compare both the product and groups of close substitutes so a product decline can be distinguished from demand transferring to another similar product.
activeVisitDirection: Do not infer 'currently visiting' automatically from being within 100m.
GPS proximity is candidate discovery only because adjacent vending machines can be a few meters apart and are worked sequentially.
The user explicitly starts one machine as active work; only one active machine may exist at a time.
Starting another machine while one is active requires a switch confirmation.
Persist the active machine across app reopen and clear it automatically on visit completion.
Preferred Today order: WORK PROGRESS, report capture, active-work / nearby compact area, then the normal Today list.
When no machine is active, show nearby candidates compactly rather than promoting one automatically; adjacent candidates must remain distinguishable.
When a machine is active, pin a compact active-work card near the top and avoid duplicating it in the normal list where practical.
OCR identity should be compared with the active machine; matching identity is positive confirmation and mismatch must warn before mis-association.
handoff.antiLoopRule: Define a finite gate checklist before testing; once all required gates pass, stop. Re-run only when code, test methodology, deployment state, or another relevant precondition changed.

recovery.authority: latest synchronized main plus canonical state files
